description: Look up one of the 64 I Ching hexagrams by number (1–64), English name ("The Wanderer"), Chinese character (旅), Japanese name (火山旅) or pinyin (ambiguous pinyin like "lu" returns the candidates). Returns its essence, judgment, image, love and career readings, guidance and the six line texts.

hexagram.description: Number 1–64, English name, Japanese name or pinyin.

language.description: Output language. Use "ja" when the user writes in Japanese: Japanese card / hexagram names, meanings and links to the Japanese pages. Otherwise "en".

lines.description: Changing line numbers to highlight (1 = bottom).

name: get_hexagram
title: I Ching hexagram meaning
